a.lede: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.
a.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal

b.lede: Executives from OpenAI and Microsoft were reportedly worried about ChatGPT training that scraped millions of news articles.
b.title: Microsoft executive called OpenAI's web scraping the 'largest theft of labor in human history'
